Missing hitbox retains last observed intended point, while final actual obstruction/body lookup determines local hit/miss; no current hit authorization inferred solely from old target point. Public sibling mutability remains aggregate/admission scope, not proof normal source creates inconsistent target-position pairs.

BodyStableChoice ideal point ranks preferred body and resolved point selects an actually reachable hitbox within that same body. MovementPrevalidated bypasses range filter only after actual movement-arrival closure/collider-clearance gate; PR uses f32MAX numeric sentinel for that context, P16 explicit enum preserves meaning. Timing constructors share sequence_start/contact/end derivation once, then timers consume same contact delay. animation_ticks enforces minimum one sample; delay_ticks permits zero; finite product integer conversion intentionally saturates. LocalBodyFacing explicitly smooths render frames between replicated samples: cached rotation is current local visual integration state and copied to local Transform only on successful BodyFacingTurn. It resets on downed/posture transition and reads current camera/velocity/action/guard/target deadline every frame. Replicated rotation and render prediction need not equal each frame; this does not establish competing server authority. No explicit network-correction rebase is visible here beyond initial fallback/reset; reconciliation ownership remains actual netcode/replication dependency, no current bad correction or gameplay result claimed from this source alone.

At contact the system reobserves collider geometry and actual obstruction, removes expired local attack state, prepares one PredictedAttackContact then uses its result for ranged request and its ray for debug event. Target bodypart is selected target identity, while native obstruction test checks target body membership; server hit/damage validation remains authoritative and must not trust local report. PR keeps raw ray/positions and inline observation; P16 checked completed positions/lengths and staged contact preserve actual error-before-event order.
